other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Applying dataset-wide transformations like median imputation or frequency encoding on the entire training set before or outside the cross-validation loop leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds.

summary: The agent provides a strong, sophisticated solution with extensive feature engineering, k-fold cross-validation, and an optimized ensemble using Nelder-Mead. The only notable flaw is a moderate cross-validation leakage where global medians and frequency encodings are computed on the entire training set rather than independently within each fold, which may lead to slightly over-optimistic OOF scores.
